answer: The harbor I would price into every new account is Signed eye clinic visit history with eye clinic attestation: visits the clinic recorded across years of eye examinations, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since visits the clinic recorded across years of eye examinations takes calendar time as well as money — and the falcon is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The opal is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
